events.scope: During the C64 screening run, as identified by campaign operator

jit_observations.interpretation: Shape warmup was incomplete. Raw latency spikes and all request samples are retained; no outlier removal or warmed-comparison claim.

limitations: Only C1 then C64 were screened; baseline warmed across the full increasing concurrency matrix. These are not matched warmed trials.
Inference-time JIT compilation was logged, including during C64; observed metrics cannot establish warmed comparative gain or regression.
No quality qualification, full candidate matrix or repeated alternating AB/BA trials exist in this bundle.
Both raw RTF values exceed their requested targets; these screening observations are not campaign acceptance.
PCM sample frames/s is reported, not codec frames/s.

Host device indices represented as logical 0/1
